issues.problem: Cue (couple marrying after years) and context 2 (结婚是…的事) fit 顺理成章 (cy500, same set) just as well.
issues.action: Replaced the cue with a bakery whose years of groundwork make a second shop come easily; replaced context 2 with a team winning the title after two seasons of gelling. Su Shi story checked against 答秦太虚书 and kept.

issues.problem: Contexts 1, 2 and 4 (也是…, 为了…, 这叫…) fit 有备无患 (cy182, same set) equally well.
issues.action: Rewrote them into verb-phrase slots that 有备无患 cannot fill (就是在未雨绸缪; 趁…未雨绸缪，提前…; 趁现在未雨绸缪，不能等…). 诗经 story kept.

issues.problem: The story said Qin collapsed 'within a few years' of unification (it lasted about fifteen years), which overstates what 贾谊 says (亟绝, 'perished quickly'). The lit line 'mirror held up by the cart' was a misleading image.
issues.action: Changed it to 'collapsed so quickly'; changed lit to 'the overturned cart ahead serves as a mirror for those behind'.

issues.problem: Context 3 (一时…，愣在那里) fits 惊慌失措 (cy071) as well.
issues.action: Changed the follow-up to 没来得及想好怎么回答, so the point is having no time to respond.

issues.problem: Context 3 (an over-expensive gift to win a client) fits 弄巧成拙 (cy156) just as well.
issues.action: Replaced it with someone who keeps telling a crying person not to cry and makes her cry harder: a plain backfire with no attempt at cleverness.

issues.problem: Story was null, but there is a well-attested origin (后汉书·赵咨传: 望尘不及).
issues.action: Added a short version without the magistrate's name, saying only that he could not catch up with Zhao's carriage and saw only its dust.

issues.problem: Story left null; the 王鲁 anecdote (汝虽打草，吾已蛇惊) is attributed to different sources (南唐近事 / 酉阳杂俎).
issues.action: Left null because the source is uncertain. No change.
